facts.material: 100% nylon lace outer, 100% polyester knit slip liner (synthetic fibers, no wool)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6104 covers women's dresses, knitted; section XI note 1 does not exclude
GRI 6: 6104.43 of synthetic fibers; 6104.43.20 other (no wool); suffix .10 women's

rejected_alternatives.reason: separate knit slip of heading 6108; here the liner is part of a dress, which gives the article its character
artificial fibers, not applicable to nylon/polyester

classification.rationale: Both fibers are synthetic, so 6104.43 applies. The liner is part of the dress, which is classified as a knitted dress under heading 6104. Slip rulings H81057 and H80044 concern separate slips, so they are not cited.
